name: What types of tile and surface updates does Frasheski Construction offer?

mainEntity.name: What types of tile and surface updates does Frasheski Construction offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction provides a range of tile and surface updates for residential and commercial properties. This includes installing new ceramic, porcelain, natural stone, and mosaic tiles for bathrooms, kitchens, and other areas. We also offer surface updates such as countertop replacements, backsplashes, and flooring installations. Our services cover various materials and styles to match your design preferences and functional needs, ensuring a durable and aesthetically pleasing finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Frasheski Construction offers tile installation for bathrooms and kitchens, and surface updates like countertop and backsplash replacements.
